lines.t: Face of fire in my vision, no escape route now
Got the Cross in my chest, flesh laid face‑down now
If I rise in myself, He gon’ break me back down
So I die, so I die, so His Name outroundsEvery ego get buried in the dirt, no crown
Every thought get checked when the King come ’round
When the plumb line drops, you gon’ stand or drown
So I die, so I die, so His Name outrounds
No mirror, no man, no past on my scale
Every “golden season” fade when the True Light hail
If I flex in my pain, I’ma rob His fame
If I boast in endurance, I’ma lift my nameHe was pure, no stain, didn’t clap back once
Didn’t curse when they lashed, only bled out love
Prayed mercy for the hands that were driving the steel
I’ve been braggin’ ’bout restraint like my scars more realIf I measure by the culture, I can coast in sin
If I measure by my circle, I can still look “in”
If I measure by my story, I’ma worship my scars
But the Goal ain’t me, it’s the Man with the starsWhere there’s no holy vision, every son goes blind
So He stay before my face, cut across my pride
Every self‑made standard, every flesh‑built throne
Get crushed when the Ancient lays His hand on my soul
Face of fire in my vision, no escape route now
Face of fire in my vision, no escape route now
Face of fire in my vision, no escape route now
This that violent kind of peace, put the old man under
Holy jealousy and love, split my heart asunder
No other man my line, no past life goal
Just the Lamb on the tree, with the world in His holdI ain’t chasing former warmth, ain’t chasing old highs
Every “wholeness” I recall gotta bow to His eyes
If it don’t look like Him, let it burn, let it fall
I refuse to make an altar out of yesterday’s callSons of God to the front, lay your stories low
No more crowning yourself for the storms you rode
No “I took lashes quiet,” no “I stayed strong” brag
When Perfection took wrath and said nothing backDrop the culture comparisons, drop the church‑bred pride
Drop the self‑help vision that keeps flesh alive
We ain’t here to be improved, we’re here to be slain
’Til the only life left in the frame is His Name
Turn the volume up, let the old man choke
This the last breath of that self‑made hope
If the Cross don’t cut, then the heart won’t bow
So we scream, “Take all, take all right now!”
Face of fire in my vision, no escape route now
Face of fire in my vision, no escape route now
Face of fire in my vision, no escape route now
Let the sons all fall where the Lamb stood slain
’Til the last “I, me, mine” get washed in flame
When the self go dark and His life remains
Then He lives, then He rules, then He reigns, He reigns
